title: Ruuhu mo Innde mum alaa, mo darii e leñol ngol fotaani
intro: E nder kelle Qur’aana, ina woodi limooje ɗe inɗe mum en ndartinaa ngam miijaade e jaŋdeeji mum en. Gooto e ɗeen ruuhuuji jibinaa ko e nder leñol ngol jaɓaani nulaaɓe mum, tee oo neɗɗo ina joginoo hoolaare suuɗnde seerndi ɗum en. Nde halkaare ari, oo neɗɗo dariima e goongɗingol maɓɓe sirlu. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa ooɗoo sifaa sirlu jeertinoowo leñol mum en hade yamiroore sakkitiinde jippaade ?
clues: Mi hoɗii e leñol keewngol yeddude nelaaɓe ɓe Alla neli e mum en.
Mi nanndaani e leñol am, mi anndi goonga nde nulaaɗo ari e maandeeji laaɓtuɗi ummoraade e Joomiraawo am.
Mi suuɗii gooŋɗinal am e tooñooɓe am, miɗo anndi ɓe mbonnat mi so ɓe njiytii gooŋɗinal am.
Nde yamiroore jukkungo ɓadtii, mi hollitii e peeñcu am, mi jeertinii leñol am yo hisnu koye mum en.
Mi siftinii 6e wonde miin ko mi nulaaɗo koolaaɗo, mi seerndaani e nelaa6e ko adii, kadi 6e poti ko rewde so wonaa Alla.
Yimɓe am ina tuuma mi e majjere e majjere, kono tan jukkungo ngo ɓe njeertinaa ngo, haa jooni ina jokki e maɓɓe.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Annabi Huudu, nulaaɗo faade e yimɓe Aad
Gorko gooŋɗinɗo jeyaaɗo e leñol Annabi Huudu cokaaɗo
Laamɗo leñol Aad caliiɗo goonga
Sehil Annabi Saalihu sikkitiiɗo maandeeji Alla
Maleyka nelaaɗo ngam halkude yimɓe Aad
identity.answer: Gorko gooŋɗinɗo jeyaaɗo e leñol Annabi Huudu cokaaɗo

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Ñaawoore yooro e heege jarriborde muñal maɓɓe
Ñaawoore bayyinde iimanaagal yeeso leñol keefeero tooñoowo
Ñaawoore mahde laana ngam daɗde e ilam mawɗam
Ñaawoore werteede e yiite ngam goorɗinde Alla
Ñaawoore jarribeede e jawdi e ɓamtaare
trial.answer: Ñaawoore bayyinde iimanaagal yeeso leñol keefeero tooñoowo

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Wuro Makka ɗo suudu teddundu ndu mahiraa
Laddeeji jeereende leñol jeddi nelaaɗo mum en
Koɗli Madiyan ɗo Annabi Shu'aybu neldaa
Daande maayo Misra ɗo Annabi Muusaa tawaa ɗoo
Falnde yimɓe Aad, fiyi ɗum henndu ɓuuɓndu
location.answer: Laddeeji jeereende leñol jeddi nelaaɗo mum en

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Mi dañaama e laana nguurmi haa Alla yiɗi
Yimɓe am ngoongɗinii caggal am, njiidaama e laawol peewal
Mbari-mi ko leñol am kono yurmeende Alla ƴetti ruuhu am
Mi tuubnii caggal nde jarribaama Allah jaɓi tuubu am
Mi waylitaama, mi wonti sanamu mo leñol am rewatnoo caggal maayde am
outcome.answer: Mbari-mi ko leñol am kono yurmeende Alla ƴetti ruuhu am

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (11:96)
